info.name: Create a new Group in the vault

params.name: external_id
params.description: Group ID in your original system, e.g., a client id.

items.docs:
Pass a vault name in the `vault` field and the group `label`.

Example of the request that creates a new group in `Team` vault with
`external_id` as `client-123`, label `John Doe`,
ssh port `22`, and ssh credentials in `username` and `password`
properties, and SSH key in the `key` property:

- path: `/v1/group/client-123/`
- body:
  ```
  {
    "vault": "Team",
    "label": "John Doe",
    "ssh": {
      "port": 22,
      "credentials": {
        "username": "username",
        "password": "pass
